desc: Implement coordinate-compressed Fenwick sliding-window median and sum-of-distances computation in \(O(n \log n)\).
Implement the \(O(nk)\) dynamic program for selecting exactly \(k\) non-overlapping length-\(x\) windows.
Verify that exactly \(k\) selections suffice for the “at least \(k\)” requirement.
Verify edge cases including \(x=n\), \(k=1\), adjacent windows, already-equal windows, negative values, duplicate values, and even \(x\).
Produce the final `Solution.minOperations` code in the required format.
